source_snapshot.procedure: Send in-band raw 0x04 0x02 with seven-byte EvMRev/sensor/event vector derived from SEL fields; generic log clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; acknowledges request bytes need confirmation but offers an incomplete unsafe example.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending exact event vector, expected SEL/routing result and side-effect policy.
historical_reviews.round_02: No approved vector or acceptance oracle located.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Get Event Receiver and SEL readers provide evidence paths but do not define this stimulus.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 missing vector is readiness only when semantics are known; here core stimulus and safety outcome remain undefined. ED-38 forbids retry.

original_test_intent: Inject one defined in-band platform event and verify the corresponding event record and routing without contaminating unrelated evidence.
original_method: Issue App 0x04/0x02 using an approved seven-byte request, then correlate its SEL entry.
manual_activity: Owner/vendor must define and approve the exact vector, containment, observation and retention/cleanup contract before one execution.
required_inputs: Seven request bytes with reserved-bit rules
Expected decoded SEL entry and receiver behavior
safety_requirements: Do not send placeholder or partial bytes
Preserve pre-test SEL; do not clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Correlate completion, SEL and receiver evidence
engineer_actions: Resolve event vector and expected semantics
Approve side-effect envelope and maintenance window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Does not fit: it supplies only three unsupported bytes for a seven-byte request and uses unsafe SSH.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command until a versioned allowlisted seven-byte vector and expected record/routing contract are approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw netfn/command, field descriptions and timing are preserved without execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve SEL baseline, validate all seven bytes against the target schema, inject one approved benign event, correlate the exact SEL/receiver/alert result, and retain or remove only the test artifact under an approved policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces placeholder injection and transport-only acceptance with a bounded semantic and side-effect contract.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command success alone does not prove the requested event was recorded or routed; a read-only check cannot substitute for injection.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong event may generate false faults, alerts or automation and can contaminate forensic history.

project_override_considerations: Another approved event-injection tool is acceptable only with equivalent seven-byte semantics, auditability and SEL/routing coverage; it does not validate raw ipmitool itself.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master leaves request data open, demands log clearing that destroys baseline, and accepts command success; DeepSeek invents a three-byte example for a seven-byte event. The event and safety semantics are unresolved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core stimulus, expected record/routing and containment are undefined, so safe execution cannot be constructed from Project readiness inputs alone.

review_improvement: Preserves the functional injection objective while preventing invented bytes, evidence deletion and false PASS from transport success.
independent_technical_reasoning: This mutation can trigger SEL, alerts and downstream automation. Because neither the exact seven-byte vector nor its expected effects are authoritative, the case remains BLOCKED rather than being reduced to a read-only check.

source_provenance.history: Adjacent event receiver/SEL cases and prior review searched
